acid-arrow.note: The 2d4 acid damage at the end of the target's next turn is dealt with the hit; a miss's half damage is not simulated.

blade-barrier.approximation: The wall (100 feet long, counted as a line) damages creatures that enter or start their turn in it; the simulator deals its damage once, when it is cast.

blindness-deafness.note: The caster blinds rather than deafens: deafness has no effect in the simulator.

cloudkill.approximation: The fog lingers and damages creatures that enter or start their turn in it; the simulator deals its damage once, when it is cast.

disintegrate.note: One creature: the record's 10-foot cube is the portion of a Huge object it destroys.

entangle.approximation: The plants restrain creatures in the area when it is cast; the escape check is Strength only in the text, where the simulator lets the target use its better of Strength and Dexterity.

flame-strike.note: A 10-foot-radius cylinder: the record's 40 is its height.

guiding-bolt.note: The advantage it grants on the next attack roll against the target is not simulated.

hold-monster.note: It has no effect on undead; the simulator does not check creature types.

hold-person.note: It targets humanoids only; the simulator does not check creature types.

insect-plague.approximation: The swarm lingers and damages creatures that enter or stay in it; the simulator deals its damage once, when it is cast.

magic-missile.note: Each dart hits a creature automatically; the darts are spread over the targets the policy picks.

power-word-kill.note: A target with 100 hit points or fewer dies outright; the spell has no effect on one with more.

shield.note: Its +5 AC lasts until the start of the caster's next turn, including against the triggering attack; the simulator keeps it up for every attack until then.

spirit-guardians.approximation: The spirits damage creatures that enter or start their turn within 15 feet for the duration; the simulator deals the damage once, when it is cast (radiant; an evil caster's is necrotic).

spiritual-weapon.note: Cast as a bonus action; its repeat attacks on later turns are not simulated.

wall-of-fire.approximation: The wall (60 feet long, counted as a line) damages creatures that stay near it; the simulator deals its damage once, when it is cast.

web.approximation: The webs restrain creatures on the turn it is cast only; creatures entering later are not simulated.
